title: Bumper Ducks
tagline: Bonk, bounce and squeak! Rubber ducks in bumper boats chase bubbles, burst giant ones and splash each other out of the tub.
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle, and tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and bonk. Grab bubbles and stars, open 🎁 for a surprise power, bump mama duck, frogs or paper boats to shake bubbles loose, and bonk friends right out of the water. Nobody is ever out, and up to four can play on their own devices.
learning: Steering and spatial awareness, cause and effect, and playing together
